Name: Compliance with Cyber Resilience Act
Beschreibung: IoT-Products provide information conforming with the Cyber Resilience Act.
Metric: {is compliant / is not compliant} with CRA

Name: Compliance Support
Beschreibung: IoT-Products support owners/controllers with informing affected people about the use of personal information.
Metric: the product {does / does not} help the owner perform his obligations towards thrid parties

Name: Seperate Data Protection Information from Terms & Conditions
Beschreibung: Data protection information should be seperated from common Terms & Conditions
Metric: data protection informantion is {spereated / not seperated} from terms and conditions

Name: Secure Default Settings
Beschreibung: IoT-Products are shipped with maximized privacy protection settings, that only allows processing of personal data relevant to the pupose of the device.
Metric: list of possible and activated settings

Name: Resetting to Secure Default Settings
Beschreibung: IoT-Products are able to be easily reset to data protection preserving and secure default settings.
Metric: products {can be / can not be} reset to private default settings

Name: Data Minimisation
Beschreibung: IoT-Products only process personal data that is necessary in relation to the prupose of the device.
Metric: list of processed personal data types

Name: Legal Grounds
Beschreibung: IoT products process personal data in accordance with a legal basis and make this transparent to the user.
Metric: list of stated legal grounds

Name: Controll of sent Data
Beschreibung: IoT-Products allow users to control the type of data that is sent.
Metric: list of data types that can be controlled to be shared

Name: Controll of Data Recipient
Beschreibung: IoT-Products allow users to controll the recipient of sent data.
Metric: list of recipients that can be selected

Name: Special Categories of Data
Beschreibung: An IoT product processes personal data of the special category
Metric: list of personal data types of special category that are processed

Name: Actors Involved in the Processing
Beschreibung: Which actors (controller, joint controller, processor) are involved.
Metric: list of involved actors and their role

Name: Availability of Contracts for Joint Controllers/Processors
Beschreibung: Contract templates are available for joint controllers/processors.
Metric: possible provided contract template

Name: Clear and Transparent Personal Data Processing Information
Beschreibung: Information on the processing of personal data is provided in a concise, transparent, intelligible, and easily accessible form.
Metric: document informing the user about data processing (privacy policy,visualization)

Name: Recipient of Information
Beschreibung: Who receives the data obtained through the use of an IoT product.
Metric: list of data recipients

Name: App Permissions Required
Beschreibung: Which access permissions must be granted for the use of an app belonging to an IoT product.
Metric: list of necessary permissions

Name: Clarification of data processing process
Beschreibung: The system informs users about the processingof data.
Metric: user {are / are not} informed about the processing of data

Name: Data Sharing
Beschreibung: Whether data collected from the use of an IoT product is shared with third parties
Metric: list of shared data types and recipients

Name: Encryption Status for User Passwords
Beschreibung: Whether access data is stored in encrypted form on the IoT products or the associated apps
Metric: User password {are / are not} stored encrypted

Name: Optional Security Review
Beschreibung: If an additional security review has taken place, it should be clear exactly which aspects were examined and who performed the tests.
Metric: list of considered aspects, entity that performed the review (if possible, the whole security review?)

Name: Authentication Information
Beschreibung: The type of user authentication of an IoT device, e.g., single-factor authentication, user-generated passowrd, no password recover
Metric: list of user authentication methods provided by the product

Name: Intuitive Privacy Control Interface
Beschreibung: The IoT-Product features an intuitive and user-friendly interface that allows users to easily control their privacy settings.
Metric: Image of the user interface

Name: Visual Representation of Privacy Flow
Beschreibung: The IoT-Product features graphical repesentations of data flows or visualizations of privacy settings
Metric: a graphic of data flows or privacy settings

Name: User controlled data processing location
Beschreibung: Users can decide for themselves where their data is processed (free choice of a cloud provider)
Metric: list of possible processing locations

Name: Contextual Data Disclosure
Beschreibung: The IoT-Product features contextualized information when users are requested to disclose data or consent to data usage.
Metric: the product {does / does not} provide contextualized information when asking for user decisions

Name: Additional Transparency Mechanisms
Beschreibung: The IoT-Product features transparency mechanisms like notice and choice designs, labels, or notifications with data-related privacy designs.
Metric: list of transparency mechanisms used

Name: Different Granularity of Privacy Settings of UI
Beschreibung: The IoT-Product presents options that define a combination of privacy settings that users can easily select to achieve their desired level of privacy without extensive manual configuration. For example, they can select between high, medium, and low privacy.
Metric: list of provided privacy setting combinations

Name: Profiling
Beschreibung: The IoT-Product features functions that involve automated decision-making (profiling)
Metric: list of features with automated decision making

Name: Subject Rights
Beschreibung: The IoT-Product (service) supports users to make use of their subject rights.
Metric: list of options provided to help users make use of their rights

Name: Listing non Personally Identifiable Information
Beschreibung: The IoT-Product provides functionality to list non-personally identifiable information (NPII) collected from IoT sensors or other sources. NPII include, for instance, temperature, humidity, and other similar metrics that do not directly identify an individual but can become personally identifiable when combined with other datasets
Metric: provided list of NPII collected by the product

Name: (Security) Update Status Display
Beschreibung: The IoT-Product provides functionality for users to gain an overview of the current system's update status.
Metric: list of provided informations regarding the update status

Name: Exploration Functionality
Beschreibung: The IoT-Product provides functionality for users to browse specific system interactions, e.g., a list of communications within the system, a list of all communications over the internet, or visualizations of activities.
Metric: list of system interactions the user can browse

Name: Investigation Functionality
Beschreibung: The IoT-Product features a log of events including errors, updates etc.�This feature would allow for in-depth tracking and thoroughly investigation of occurring issues.
Metric: list of all events that get logged

Name: Being notified when something needs attention
Beschreibung: The IoT-Product triggers notifications when users' attention is needed (e.g., in case of information being sent over the internet, errors occur, in case of abnormal or suspicious occurrences
Metric: list of events that trigger notifications

Name: User Control
Beschreibung: The IoT-Product offers to manage multiple authorized users.
Metric: the poduct {can / can not} manage multiple authorized users

Name: User Interaction and Engagement
Beschreibung: The IoT-Product offers an appropriate user interface (e.g. through an app or a web application)
Metric: list of provided interface options

Name: Privacy Enhancing Technologies
Beschreibung: The IoT-Product features PETs to safeguard users' privacy
Metric: list of used privacy enhancing technologies

Name: Data Portability
Beschreibung: The IoT-Product / related service features portability functions to migrate from/to other products
Metric: list of portability options

Name: Backend Service Demands
Beschreibung: The IoT-Product requires connection to a specific backend service
Metric: list of necessary backend services

Name: Updateability
Beschreibung: The IoT-Product features an update functionality and specifies the planned lifetime
Metric: end of lifetime date / lifetime duration

Name: History of Data Leakage
Beschreibung: Documented data leaks in connection with the IoT product
Metric: list of documented data leaks associated with the service provider

Name: Privacy Breaches
Beschreibung: There are currently known data breaches associated with the IoT product.
Metric: list of known data breaches associated with the service provider

Name: Open Source
Beschreibung: Which part of the IoT product is based on IoT software
Metric: list of open source software components used in the product

Name: TLS Certificate Validation
Beschreibung: The IoT-Product uses secure communication channels and validates server certificates
Metric: the product {does / does not} use secure communication channels

Name: Duration and the company/entity of data being stored
Beschreibung: The IoT-Product should clearly specify the duration for which the data is stored and identify the company or entity responsible for storing it
Metric: list of stored data type, storage duration and responsible entity

Name: Purpose of data being collected
Beschreibung: The IoT-Product provides a detailed explanation of the reasons for collecting the data
Metric: list of processing purposes

Name: Frequency of data being sent
Beschreibung: The IoT-Product indicates how often the data is transmitted
Metric: list of collected data type and transmission frequency

Name: Data processing outside the EU
Beschreibung: The IoT-Product indicates wether data is being transmitted outside the EU
Metric: list of data being transmitted outside the EU

Name: Location of data being sent to
Beschreibung: The IoT-Product indicates to which location (company & country) data is being transmitted
Metric: list of data recipients with country

Name: Controllable discovery function
Beschreibung: The IoT product lets the user decide whether or not to automatically search for other devices on the network
Metric: the product {does / does not} allow users to controll if the product should search for / connect with other devices in the network

Name: On-device data processing
Beschreibung: The data is preferably processed locally.
Metric: the product {does / does not} process data localy by default

Name: Account Required for Device Bootstrapping
Beschreibung: An account is required to set up the IoT device.
Metric: the product {does / does not} need an account to be used

Name: Ensure informed consent to changes in data processing
Beschreibung: An interface enables users to compare current and new terms side-by-side with highlighted changes. This ensures informed consent.
Metric: the product provides the functionality to compare current and new Privacy Policy
